capabilities: High-dimensional fixed effects, IV, event studies and robust covariance
limitation: Fast TWFE remains inappropriate for some heterogeneous staggered effects
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.role: Python high-dimensional fixed-effect and panel candidate
scientific_qualification.input: Formula-based outcomes, treatments, high-dimensional effects, weights, instruments and selected DiD/inference method.
scientific_qualification.output: Selected regression or event-study effect and declared covariance.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: The chosen regression/DiD estimand is identified; weights and dependence model match the target.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: Do not convert a staggered-treatment request automatically into TWFE. Pin CPU/GPU backend and demeaning tolerances; declared speed/features are not this project's measured performance.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: Recover a projection with explicit dummy variables; use heterogeneous cohort effects to distinguish TWFE from cohort ATT; compare weighted residualization and cluster covariance.

evidence.finding: FE/IV/GLM and DiD features, inference choices and backend declarations.
